component.name: SumMRIse
component.summary: View MRI, CT and PET scans from hospital discs

description.p: SumMRIse opens the DICOM images that hospitals hand out on CDs, DVDs and USB sticks, and the ZIP files and disc images they send. It shows every series with correct anatomical orientation, contrast presets, multiplanar reformatting, a 3D view, PET uptake values, measurements and the reports on the disc, and explains in plain language what each series is. All processing happens on the computer: nothing is uploaded.
SumMRIse is not a medical device and must not be used for diagnosis.
